transcript.advisory: Built from the YAML above (not a recorded triage trace) -- review the steps before saving.
transcript.final_yaml:
collection: 00 - FSR Studio
playbooks:
- name: Block Malicious IP on FortiGate
  trigger: start
  is_active: true
  steps:
  - type: start
    name: Start
    next: Containment Target Present
    module: alerts
  - type: decision
    name: Containment Target Present
    conditions:
    - display: target present
      when: '{{ (((vars.input.records[0].destinationIp) | default('''', true)) | length) > 0 }}'
      next: Confirm Containment
    default: Containment Target Empty
  - type: manual_input
    name: Confirm Containment
    message: Run containment `block_ip_new` via `fortigate-firewall`? Choose Stop to skip it and continue.
    options:
    - display: Confirm
      next: Block IP on FortiGate
    - display: Stop
      next: Containment Skipped
  - type: connector
    name: Block IP on FortiGate
    connector: fortigate-firewall
    operation: block_ip_new
    method: Quarantine Based
    ip_addresses: '{{ vars.input.records[0].destinationIp }}'
    time_to_live: 12 Hour
  - type: set_variable
    name: Containment Target Empty
    vars:
      containment_skipped: true
      containment_skipped_reason: empty_target
  - type: set_variable
    name: Containment Skipped
    vars:
      containment_skipped: true
transcript.summary: Blocks the alert's destination IP on FortiGate (Quarantine Based banned-IP list, 12-hour TTL). Runs only if the alert has a destination IP and the analyst confirms the containment step. Assumes destinationIp is the malicious indicator; it is the outbound peer, not the compromised source host.

trigger.label: Runs when an analyst starts it on an alert
